summary: End-to-end testing of Permission Demo App: backend CRUD APIs (demo-links, visit-logs) and frontend UI flow (Home generator, /googleauthpro/{code} route on desktop and mobile, /l/{code} backward-compat, Link History, View Details). All 6 backend pytest tests passed and all UI flows verified.
critical_code_review_comments: DemoPage.requestContactsPermission gates on 'ContactsManager' in window which is correct for feature detection but may be false in many Chromium versions even when navigator.contacts exists; in headless this safely returns 'unsupported' as expected.
DetailsView/LinkHistory components rely on Home state for back navigation; conditional rendering pattern works but URL state isn't preserved on refresh (would benefit from real routes).
Permission Required screen is shown when ANY permission denied; this is correct per spec but be aware unsupported contacts/skipped photos do NOT trigger it (good).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST demo links and visit logs at runtime; left in DB (no cleanup needed since data is harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses FRONTEND_URL env var to construct demo_url as `${FRONTEND_URL}/googleauthpro/{code}`. Frontend route /googleauthpro/:demoCode renders DemoPage which: 1) fetches demo link, 2) shows 'Connecting to <hostname>...' white screen briefly, 3) requests all selected permissions, 4) POSTs visit-log, 5) redirects on success or shows 'Permission Required' on any denial. In headless browsers camera/mic/location auto-deny so you'll see Permission Required screen after ~2-3s. To catch 'Connecting to' use wait_for_selector with short timeout right after navigation. Mobile viewport 390x844 same behavior; photos/contacts only trigger UI on /Android|iPhone/ UA detection in DemoPage.isMobileDevice() — test viewport size alone is NOT enough to trigger them; you'd need to override userAgent. data-testid IDs used: url-input, generate-link-btn, permission-{id}-checkbox, copy-link-btn, generated-link-input, view-details-btn, menu-btn, link-history-btn.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. The previous fork's broken DEMO_DOMAIN=googleauthpro.app issue has been fully resolved. demo_url now correctly returns `https://photo-logger-app-1.preview.emergentagent.com/googleauthpro/{code}` and the route resolves to DemoPage on both desktop and mobile viewports. The old /l/{code} backward-compat route also works.
